component: MailNews body-search charset and fixture boundary

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new plain-text Greek fixture declares ISO-8859-7 and 8bit encoding. Its test supplies Καλησπέρα with op: Contains and expects 2 aggregate hits alongside the existing multipart fixture. The production edit clarifies the pre-existing boundary: multipart parsing may return a part charset; otherwise MatchBody uses its supplied message charset. The immediate caller reads the message charset and uses defaultCharset if empty. Renaming folderCharset to msgCharset documents that input without adding a new fallback. These are exact fixture/source/assertion facts, not a passed search or decoding run.
title: The simple Greek body-search fixture uses the supplied message charset fallback
